data.body:
[P2] Isolate deferred export failures from parent scope setup

This drain runs inside `on_user_function_start`, before `_attach_context`. If a callback completed during suspension and its processor raises when replay registers the parent, `_render_operation_end` re-raises because `_finalization` is still None. Core contains that exception and executes the parent's body without attaching its OTel context, so user-created spans and correlated logs use the outer context. Later export retries cannot repair their parentage. Contain ordinary failures per pending completion while retaining retry state and allowing parent setup to finish; add a replay regression with a processor that fails once.
